chunk.content: Eleutheronema tetradactylum is one of the most important fisheries species for Kuwait, India, Thailand, Viet Nam, Malaysia, Singapore and Indonesia; it is mainly caught by gill net, sometimes by trawl, and is also an important sport fish in Australian waters.
